csv_project_name: Engineering for Statewide Bridge Rehabilitation FY27-28
csv_scope_of_work: As part of the Ohio Department of Natural Resources (ODNR) statewide bridge rehabilitation program, ODNR is requesting professional engineering services to provide planning, design, and construction administration services for statewide bridge improvement projects. A summary of anticipated projects is provided below for reference. SFN 2626454 Harrison State Park Parks & Watercraft SFN 7326815 Shawnee State Forest Forestry Blackhand Gorge Nature Preserve Natural Areas/Preserves The selected firms shall use ODOT and ODNR inspection reports and conduct site inspections to propose design alternatives and develop a final design to bring the structures to an acceptable general appraisal rating. The selected A/E firms should consider innovative structures or construction techniques for improved constructability and to minimize permitting and environmental impacts.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Soil Testing, Construction/Project Management, Materials Testing, Analytical/Testing Services, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Forestry, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
